lead.en: A position paper arguing that nation is generative and prior to borders, and that country is an administrative artefact.

items.en: The target of three macro-regional identities is a design goal, and falsifiable.

text.en: Nation is prior to any border; country is a bordered administrative artefact created by a political ideology. The claim that L4 is prior to L6 is ontological, not chronological.
The founder's full text is written in the first person and has not been reproduced here. This record states what the declaration claims, where it is used on this site, and what would refute it.

body.en: A declaration is a working framework, not a final definition. Each claim above is stated so that a reader can check it and file a correction.
